svg.title: Online softmax: rescale and retain the accumulator
svg.desc: Illustrative one-row values: logits 0 and ln2, values 4 and 8. Equivalent numerator form u=ell times O of FlashAttention Algorithm1. Initial m=-infinity, ell=0,u=0. First totals 0,1,4. New max ln2 rescales previous ell and u by 1/2; adding the second block gives ell=1.5,u=10 and output 20/3. The rescale-only frame is an intermediate calculation, not a separate storage write. GPU storage and latency are omitted.

g.text: Rescale ℓ and u by ½
The first block contributes weight 1 and value 4.
A larger maximum rescales the previous totals.
Keep the totals; incorporate the next block.
